items.title: Blog post: "The Great House Farm Story"
items.summary: A public blog post about Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, and BP Properties Ltd v Buckler, with the blog's own publication date of 29 Aug 2012. No comments on the post.
items.note: The text now on the page was revised on 26 Jul 2026. The earliest Internet Archive copy is from 11 Aug 2025, so the 2012 wording is not on record. A fresh Internet Archive copy was made on 21 Oct 2026.
